description: Charms: rings and amulets that change a rule (D592, Hollow Knight style), read by Scripts/Systems/Charms.gd. Each charm gives and takes; numbers are provisional (design/charms_plan.md). Effects: parry_heal = share of max HP healed per parry; no_block = 1 turns block (and parry) off; roll_length = roll lasts longer by this share; roll_stamina = share added to the roll's stamina cost (D776); skill_sp_cost = share added to every skill's SP cost; skill_heal = share added to every skill heal (the flask too); staggered_damage = extra share of hero melee damage on a staggered or stunned enemy; flask_charges = extra flask sips; flask_heal = share added to each sip; sp_on_kill = SP per kill. Icons are stand-ins until charm art exists.
